name: European long distance path E3 - part Luxembourg
description_md:
The European long distance path E3 part Luxembourg is a waymarked hiking route in Luxembourg. It is signposted as E3 and belongs to the international waymarked hiking network.

The route spans a distance of 240.5 km with 8310 m of ascent and 8079 m of descent. This trail has a hard difficulty derived from distance and ascent, requiring about 82 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. Walkers will find that the path passes the European Museum Schengen within 100 m, the Schengen Agreement within 100 m, and Vianden Castle within 100 m.
